ILIKEITLIKETHAT (6) comes here fresh from success a week-and-a-half ago over 2130m at this track, scoring by 8 metres. Another big performance is on the cards. NEVELE ARMA (12) comes here fresh from victory a week-and-a-half ago over 2130m at this track, scoring by 9 metres. Another big performance is on the cards. OUR ROBYN HOOD (11) comes here fresh from a third a week-and-a-half ago over 2130m at this track, beaten 11 metres. Another big performance is expected if the gaps come at the right time.
